summary: Restoration pledges include planting 3,000,000 trees in urban areas over the next five years, restoring at least 2,200 hectares of mangroves by 2030 and an additional 1,000 hectares of modified or degraded forested wetlands by 2035. Mixed restoration-and-conservation commitments include 7,000 hectares of mangrove restoration and protection by 2027, increasing closed-broadleaf forest coverage from 7.7% to 10% by 2035, and maintaining 30% of total tree cover in Local Planning Areas. Conservation targets protect approximately 67% of mangrove forests by 2033, conserve at least 30% of forested wetlands by 2033, and include a conditional target to conserve 100% of seagrass ecosystems in gazetted protected areas by 2035. The Yallahs-Hope project concerns watersheds that account for around 7% of the island's farmlands. Forest covers 72.6% of Jamaica, agriculture 15.2%, mapped wetlands 0.5%, and settlement 2.8%, framing the forest, mangrove and urban pledges.

targets.context: The planting focus is urban; settlement land cover is 309 km² (2.8% of Jamaica).
